title: Beta design partners tracker — Hosted canary rollouts (GA workflow)
content:
Last updated: 2025-05-02 (Simran)

Purpose
- Working tracker for Hosted canary rollout workflow beta design partners.
- We’re using this to drive: enablement sequencing, feedback capture, GA readiness signal, and comms.

Legend
- Readiness: ✅ Ready for GA / 🟡 Conditional / ❌ Not ready
- Severity: P0 = customer-impacting incident, P1 = blocks rollout workflow, P2 = significant UX/paper cut, P3 = nice-to-have
- “Routes involved” refers to Hosted routes in Console (route name) + API path (if applicable)

Notes / reminders
- Please keep “Issues found” short + link to Jira/Linear/Slack where possible.
- If a customer requests a feature outside GA scope (quality gates automation, Dedicated parity), capture in “Follow-ups” with owner.

Rollup (non-binding)
- Total DPs enabled: 6
- Actively running/used rollouts: 6
- “✅ Ready for GA” signals: 4 (Northstar, AurumHR, DocuSage, Canyon)
- “🟡 Conditional” signals: 2 (Emberfin = audit/policy messaging; HelioTravel = threshold guidance + burst handling)

Top recurring themes (what to fix / clarify before GA)
1) Auto-stop/rollback defaults need better guidance + tier recommendations (bursty traffic = false positives)
2) Policy denial messaging must say: what rule tripped + required role/action (resume/approve)
3) Audit events: consistency + ensure route_id/rollout_id/cohort + “diff” completeness (guardrail edits + schedule edits)
4) Split mismatch runbook + verification steps should be easy to follow (post-incident)

Open questions (captured from calls)
- Do we recommend a standard “soak time by step” default per traffic volume? (Sean/Paula)
- Customer-facing guidance on streaming/retries + stickiness (Wei)
- How do we want to message limitations (no time-based scheduling, no automated quality gates) in GA docs? (Marissa/Elliot)
